propositions: A new plan-review criterion ac-process-gate must flag acceptance criteria that restate generic, ticket-agnostic mechanical process gates (children-closed, tests/CI pass, plan-review passes, etc.) that rebar or CI enforces for every ticket.

The criterion must accept and pass acceptance criteria that name or depend on the specific ticket deliverable (e.g., tests written for a named feature, a named criterion rubric update), even when testing or plan-review is the subject.

The ac-process-gate criterion must be registered as a 1-TURN non-code-grounded member of CANONICAL_LLM, routed with facet ac-text-quality and scope [container, leaf], and shipped with advisory posture.

The rubric prompt, routing entry, deterministic unit tests, guide documentation, and bounded-sanity eval corpus must all conform to the established built-in-criterion pattern (mirrors necessity, epic 6982/R4) with live kappa=1.0 validation.

The fix to chunk_by_facet packer must eliminate singleton chunks (e.g., n=25 tipped old packer; new packer guarantees [2, size] for n≥2) while maintaining facet adjacency and passing 2–39 regression coverage.
